summary: Build ISO 45001 audit skills through PECB training. Practise audit planning, evidence evaluation, nonconformity reporting, and exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who audit, advise on, or prepare occupational health and safety management systems against ISO 45001. It is most relevant when your work includes audit planning, conformity evaluation, reporting, or audit program responsibilities.
modules: Stage 2 Audit Activities and Test Plans
prerequisites: Participants should have a fundamental understanding of ISO 45001 and comprehensive knowledge of audit principles.
